intro.text: Ladies and gentlemen, welcome to the Squabble! Gold corner, the Buyers. Red corner, the Sellers. Three rounds, real tape, no script.

r1.text: Round one! Touch gloves and let the tape talk.

r2.text: Round two! Shake it off, here we go again.

r3.text: Final round! Leave it all on the tape.

pump.text: Pump, pump! Buyers pressing the action!

dump.text: Ooh, that's a dump! Sellers dropped the hammer!

drag.text: Sellers dragging it down, slow and mean.

flip.text: Flip! Somebody took that round back!

absorbed.text: Absorbed! All that effort, and the price ain't budge.

clinch.text: Clinch! They hugging it out in the middle.

haymaker.text: Haymaker! Oh, somebody felt that one!

knockdown.text: He's down! He's down! Count it!

buyers_win.text: Buyers take it! Gold corner, give 'em their flowers!

sellers_win.text: Sellers take it! Red corner running the block tonight!

draw.text: It's a draw! Ain't nobody going home happy.

call_it.text: Make your call before the bell!

correct.text: You called it! Student of the game!

wrong.text: The tape got you this time. Run it back.
